AssistantUpdate.description:
Fields to change; omitted (or null) fields stay. ``no_source_message`` empty or null
restores the default message.
AssistantUpdate.title: AssistantUpdate

CitationOut.description:
A numbered source of an answer (``docs/specs/chat-sse.md``). The location fields came
with the real retriever (v0.3); answers saved before have them as ``null``.
CitationOut.title: CitationOut

CollectionUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted or null fields stay.
CollectionUpdate.title: CollectionUpdate

ConversationChannel.description: Where the conversation happens; other channels (widget, Slack...) come later.
ConversationChannel.title: ConversationChannel

MessageStatus.description:
Lifecycle of a message. User messages are always ``completed``.

An assistant message starts ``streaming`` (LLM answering) and ends ``completed``,
``failed`` (provider error) or ``interrupted`` (client gone). ``no_source`` marks the
fallback answer given without calling the LLM because retrieval found nothing (rule 8 of
AGENTS.md): the panel shows the offer to open a ticket for it.
MessageStatus.title: MessageStatus

ProfileUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted (or null) fields keep their value.
ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate

ProviderTestError.description:
Same shape as the API error body: ``provider_auth_failed``, ``provider_rate_limited``,
``provider_unavailable`` or ``provider_request_failed``.
ProviderTestError.title: ProviderTestError

ProviderUpdate.description: Fields to change; omitted fields stay. ``base_url: null`` clears it.
ProviderUpdate.title: ProviderUpdate

Role.description: Per-workspace role, from most to least privileged.
Role.title: Role

RunErrorStage.description: Pipeline step where a document failed.
RunErrorStage.title: RunErrorStage

SourceTestError.description:
Same shape as the API error body (``source_unavailable``, ``path_outside_root``,
``branch_not_found``, ``source_timeout``...).
SourceTestError.title: SourceTestError

SourceUpdate.description:
Fields to change; omitted or null fields stay, except ``schedule_cron: null``, which
clears it. ``config`` is replaced whole (validated against the source's kind).
SourceUpdate.title: SourceUpdate
